first_grpo.note: GRPO v2 started from the base model with no SFT. Train reward stayed on the ~0.10 format floor (572 log rows, last step 230). SFT warm-up then 150 GRPO steps is the run that worked: TEST 0.0185 → 0.575 → 0.839. Same Plan A protocol, greedy: Luna 0.252 / Haiku 0.197. The 3B LoRA beats them at this JSON citation format; it does not beat their tool-calling scores.

checkpoints.label: SFT warm-up
checkpoints.detail: 1 LoRA epoch, 984 of 1229 train prompts, 123 steps. Teaches format and copying the answer out of packed records.

checkpoints.label: GRPO × 150 from SFT
checkpoints.detail: Dense-reward GRPO, 150 steps from the SFT adapter. Best adapter. Train mean 0.86; TEST 0.839 / 80.6% pass.

checkpoints.label: GRPO v2 (no SFT)
checkpoints.detail: Negative result. No SFT, train reward stuck at the format floor. No held-out TEST eval. Use GRPO × 150 instead.
